name: Damask
blurb: Damask is an automatic wallpaper application.
description:
Damask is an automatic wallpaper application. It currently supports setting the wallpaper image from the following sources:

• wallhaven.cc

• Microsoft Bing Wallpaper of the day

• NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day

• Google Earth View

• Microsoft Spotlight

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
